assumptions: One hot SKU dominates; others behave normally
The payment provider supports idempotency keys and retries webhooks
Authentication scopes buyer IDs and receipts. Reused operation IDs with changed payloads conflict; receipt retention defines an explicit retry window.

Payment calls occur only after a durable held decision. Provider signatures are checked. Unknown outcomes use the same payment key; refunds are durable compensation intents with their own retry receipts.
Single-writer actors require fenced partition ownership and durable checkpoint/offset coordination; single-threaded reference tests do not prove that infrastructure.
Provider idempotency retention is bounded. Unknown outcomes outside that window require provider/manual reconciliation, never a fresh blind charge.
Reference tests model bounded mechanisms; they do not qualify production concurrency, failure recovery or latency.
solutions.chooseWhen: The database row is the stock authority; one conditional update both checks and takes stock, so concurrency cannot oversell.
